scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-api python -m shipsense_api.export_openapi && npm run generate --workspace packages/contracts
scripts.test:foundation: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-api python -m unittest discover -s services/api/tests -v
scripts.test:readiness:integration: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-api python -m unittest discover -s services/api/tests -p test_readiness_integration.py -v
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check services scripts packages/local-core
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --frozen ruff format services scripts packages/local-core
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && uv run --frozen ruff check services scripts packages/local-core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/contracts && uv run --frozen mypy
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run secrets:check && npm run contracts:check
scripts.local:up: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-local python -m shipsense_local.cli up
scripts.local:down: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-local python -m shipsense_local.cli down
scripts.local:reset: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-local python -m shipsense_local.cli reset
scripts.local:check: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-local python -m shipsense_local.cli check
scripts.fixtures:seed: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-local python -m shipsense_local.cli seed
scripts.test:local: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-local python -m unittest discover -s packages/local-core/tests -p test_unit.py -v
scripts.test:local:integration: uv run --frozen --package shipsense-api python -m unittest discover -s packages/local-core/tests -p test_integration.py -v
